purpose: Primary-source refresh for two superficially attractive realtime/NBBO paths; negative evidence only and never PASS authority.

primary_source_findings: Webull retail help documents National Best Bid and Offer per-query data as free for all users and describes coverage of 16 U.S. exchanges plus FINRA TRF.
Webull OpenAPI Market Data API separately states that U.S. stocks/ETFs require a Nasdaq Basic Level 1 or Nasdaq TotalView Level 2 subscription specifically for Non-Display OpenAPI usage.
Webull states mobile/desktop quote subscriptions do not transfer to OpenAPI; a separate OpenAPI market-data subscription is required.
Webull API eligibility help states an active Webull brokerage account is required and the API application requires a minimum net account value of $100.

Therefore the free display/per-query NBBO entitlement cannot be transferred to scheduler/non-display OpenAPI use, and the $100 account-value condition independently violates strict permanent-$0/no-balance-condition gate C.
providers.reopen_condition: Official Webull primary source must explicitly grant consolidated National-NBBO-capable OpenAPI/non-display access permanently at $0 with no separate market-data subscription and no minimum account value/funding/activity condition.

primary_source_findings: Alpha Vantage documents consolidated U.S. market coverage and identifies itself as a Nasdaq-licensed provider.
Its realtime U.S. quotes, realtime bid/ask and realtime intraday entitlement are explicitly premium-only; free/default quote freshness is not qualifying realtime G9.
Alpha Vantage support explicitly says realtime and 15-minute-delayed U.S. stock market data are premium-only because of exchange/FINRA/SEC market-data regulation.
Therefore strong lineage/licensing does not solve strict G9 because permanent-$0 realtime entitlement fails gate C.
providers.reopen_condition: Official Alpha Vantage primary source must make realtime consolidated U.S. NBBO/bid-ask/trade API entitlement permanently $0 for the exact automated personal use, with no subscription or other monetary condition.
